row.prompt: Subject: eicosapentaenoic acid, target meaning the twenty-carbon omega-three fatty acid with five cis double bonds (エイコサペンタエン酸). Composition: One ball-and-stick heavy-atom molecular model contains exactly twenty gray carbon spheres and two red oxygen spheres. Count the carboxyl carbon as the first carbon; show cis double bonds between chain positions five-six, eight-nine, eleven-twelve, fourteen-fifteen and seventeen-eighteen. The acid end has one double-bonded red oxygen and one singly bonded red oxygen with a small white hydrogen; omit carbon-bound hydrogens. No atom letters, position numerals, formula, abbreviation, legend or fish props. Deliver one 512x512 PNG with genuine RGBA transparency outside all subjects and in all gaps. Use thick dark-brown rounded outlines, rounded simple 2D forms, restrained flat cel shading and clean neutral colors without a yellow cast. The whole subject group occupies 80-90% of the longest canvas dimension with clear safe margins, no cropped body parts or objects. No text, letters, numerals, labels, speech balloons, logos, watermarks, decorative icons, border, frame, pedestal or unrelated scenery.
row.note: Rarity 1200 inclusive boundary reviewed. Definition evidence: https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chebi/CHEBI:28364 ; https://www.cancer.gov/publications/dictionaries/cancer-drug/def/eicosapentaenoic-acid. Original source fields preserved; no new text exception.
